sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOBBIES_1_297' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of sales (y) for the specified item_id (HOBBIES_1_297), grouped by quarter (ds), using the m5_calendar for the time axis.
